name: FILEN-029: the device's sync state, which names every file, is readable by its owner only
description: FILEN-029 (Filen): the CLI wrote master keys into a 0644 file readable by every local user. Rule S19: the state folder is 0700 and its files 0600; keys live in the OS keyring. sync-chaos sec-local-secrets-hygiene.

name: FILEN-029: a pair folder whose name holds quotes and $(...) runs nothing
description: FILEN-029 (Filen): an iCloud check ran exec(`xattr "${path}"`) through a shell, so a sync root containing quotes or $(...) could run commands. Rule S19 (no shell is ever spawned with a path).
